_notes._about: Zalo Desktop 26.11 (snapshot 2026-11-20) -> zalors shadow. Written from the shape-only inventory in batch 13, revised in batch 14 using ONLY the whitelisted --distinct code-column tool plus the probe_import_overlap arbiter, revised again in batch 15 using --distinct --all-dbs plus the probe_import_codes cross-tab against the shadow payload's $.msgType, and COMPLETED in batch 25 from Claude's static read of the Zalo PC 26.11.12 app source (see note 'msgType'). Every field whose meaning is still not settled is marked here.
_notes.msgType: COMPLETED IN BATCH 25 from the source of truth: Claude's static read of the Zalo PC 26.11.12 bundle pc-dist/sync-v2-sub-worker.*.js. The Desktop message.msgType column holds a numeric MSG_* constant exported by one module of that bundle, and the same bundle carries the switch that turns each constant into its wire msgType string; combined, every code that HAS a wire string is mapped below: 1 MSG_TEXT -> webchat, 2 MSG_PHOTO -> chat.photo, 11 MSG_PHOTO_2 -> chat.photo, 3 MSG_VOICE -> chat.voice, 4 MSG_STICKER -> chat.sticker, 5 MSG_DOODLE -> chat.doodle, 6 MSG_CONTACT -> chat.recommended, 7 MSG_GIF -> chat.gif, 17 MSG_LOCATION -> chat.location.new, 18 MSG_VIDEO -> chat.video.msg, 19 MSG_FILE -> share.file, 20 MSG_UNDO -> chat.undo, 21 MSG_OA -> chat.list.action, 25 MSG_ECARD -> chat.ecard, 26 MSG_POLL -> group.poll, 52 MSG_ZINSTANT -> chat.webcontent, -27 MSG_DEL_EVERYONE -> chat.delete.everyone, 2506 MSG_TODO -> chat.todo. Supporting evidence kept: the batch-15 cross-tab (probe_import_codes, snapshot 2026-11-20 x live shadow, 1472 DBs, 467616 desktop rows, 493 matched) agrees for 1/2/4/6/18 (279/154/36/9/9 matched rows, purity 100.0%) and for 19 -> share.file (2 matched, purity 100.0%), 21 -> chat.list.action (1 matched, a wire string seen nowhere else in the shadow) and 52 -> chat.webcontent (2 matched, purity 100.0%); the batch-24 decrypted content shapes agree (19 has checksum/fileExt/fileSize; 17 has lat/lo; 25 has versionEcardNewFr; 52 has customMsg/pcItem; 7 is photo-like with contentId; 21 is a JSON array; 20 includes {cliMsgId, deleteMsg, globalMsgId}). CONFLICT, resolved by the code: one batch-15 cross-tab hit said 20 -> webchat (1 matched row of 2119); the Zalo PC 26.11.12 switch says MSG_UNDO -> chat.undo, and the source code wins - 20 is mapped to chat.undo, never to webchat.
_notes.msgType_unmapped: After batch 25 the only DELIBERATELY unmapped codes are -4 (MSG_INFO) and -1909 (MSG_INFO_CHAT): the Zalo PC 26.11.12 switch has NO wire msgType string for them - they are LOCAL INFO rows the Desktop writes into its own message table as bookkeeping, not chat messages, so there is nothing a Desktop->wire table could map them to. The batch-15 census counted -4 x 278 and -1909 x 128 such rows; every other census code is now mapped (19 x 8418, 20 x 2119, 21 x 459, 52 x 343, 26 x 334, -27 x 41, 17 x 120, 7 x 79, 25 x 65, 3 x 30, 5 x 1 - see note 'msgType'). The apply preflight lists them with their counts: without --unmapped-as-raw the apply REFUSES on them; with it they are stored kind=100 with text forced NULL (content kept only in payload_json, the raw code string included) - never JSON-as-text. Skipping them at extract time instead of hatching them is a possible later user decision, recorded here and NOT implemented. Any OTHER code the census reports after batch 25 (e.g. an unknown 999) is a code the Zalo PC 26.11.12 source did not name - treat it as new evidence and re-run probe_import_codes before mapping it.
_notes.type_arbiter: probe_import_overlap's NUMERIC type agreement is still degenerate as an arbiter: the still-soaking pre-H1-fix build writes every real wire msgType into the 100 bucket (batch-14 baseline agreed 259/264; mapping '1'->webchat dropped it to 48/264 — that measures the shadow's broken bucket, not the mapping). Batch 15 adds the meaningful axis: the probe now ALSO reports 'type_str' agreement, comparing the import's MAPPED msgType string with the shadow payload's $.msgType string (the original wire value). Batch 15 also resolved the code table itself through that same payload string via probe_import_codes (see note 'msgType'), so msgId/ts/sender/type_str are all valid arbiters today; only the numeric type axis needs a re-run after deploy. Batch 25 supersedes the cross-tab as the table's source (the Zalo PC 26.11.12 source read, note 'msgType') but the type_str axis remains the live arbiter for a re-run after the capture build redeploys.
_notes.entities.message.columns.msgId: SETTLED by the batch-14 probe: msgId matches shadow msgId string-for-string (264 matches, 4 conversations at 100.0% overlap), so the TEXT pk is the server msgId; cliMsgId stays a carried envelope extra.
_notes.entities.message.columns.ts: serverTime (TEXT) read as epoch ms is CONFIRMED the best source: batch-14 probe ts agreement 252/264 stable across runs; the originTs alternative was TESTED and rejected (probe: desktop=0 in every conversation — originTs is NULL/unusable for essentially all rows, extraction skips everything); sendDttm was already worse in batch 13 (188/263 — sender's device clock, per-conv clusters). Residual 12/264 ts disagreements concentrate in 2 conversations (8659d411f54a: 5, b5ca996db982: 7 — h12 only) and are the remaining open ambiguity; plausibly edited/re-delivered rows whose wire ts differs from the Desktop serverTime. No further mapping lever exists; escalation or a post-deploy re-run can revisit.
_notes.entities.message.columns.msgType_consequ: Batch 25 completes the code table, so every code with a wire string now lands its real kind code (normalize::msg_type_code): 20 and -27 join the recall family 8 (with chat.delete / V1 recall), 52 joins chat.webcontent 9, and the new strings land the new codes - chat.list.action 14, chat.ecard 15, group.poll 16, chat.todo 17 - while 17 (MSG_LOCATION) lands chat.location.new's existing code 13; content_json parses their JSON-text content into the wire object/array shape for those kinds. The only rows that still land kind=100 are the local-info codes -4/-1909 (note 'msgType_unmapped', stored via --unmapped-as-raw with NULL text) plus any code the Zalo PC 26.11.12 source did not name. The batch-15 warning 'Do NOT run apply (2.5) until the code table is completed' is now satisfied; the apply's own preconditions (docs/import-mapping.md section 7) still apply unchanged.
_notes.entities.message.columns.content: Chose the 'message' column (the per-kind Index.db tables image/file/link also carry 'message' as the content blob, so it is read as the wire-content column). Alternatives: 'content', 'msgText'. The probe compares msgId/ts/sender only, so it cannot arbitrate the content column; unchanged from batch 13.
_notes.entities.message.columns.uidFrom: SETTLED by the batch-14 probe: self-sent rows store '0' — the probe's 129 'no sender on one side' matches are Desktop self-sent rows (uidFrom='0' -> sender NULL on the import side; the capture side substitutes the own uid) and sender agreement is 135/135 wherever both sides have one. The real-own-uid alternative is ruled out.
_notes.entities.message.columns.idTo: toUid confirmed by test: the documented {"const":"$db_id"} alternative was TESTED in batch 14 (probe run 4) and changed nothing (TOTAL identical: matched=264, pct=69.5%) — for one2one the derivation prefers uidFrom, and self-sent rows' toUid already equals the DB file digits. Keep toUid: it also works for stranger, where $db_id is invalid by plan rule.
_notes.entities.message.db: stranger is included although the stranger_box sample has 0 rows (same schema as the other message DBs).
_notes.entities.conversation: Index.db 'conversation' has no title/avatar/last_ts columns; nothing is mapped for them. lastSmsLocalId is deliberately NOT mapped to last_msg_id: it is a LOCAL id, not a server msgId, and would poison conversations.last_msg_id. Batch-14 --distinct on conversation.isGroup shows a clean {0: 950, 1: 108} boolean split (1058 rows), supporting the isGroup reading.
_notes.entities.contact: Index.db has both 'friend' (775 rows) and 'friends_info' (638 rows, superset schema with friendRequest* columns); 'friend' is read as the live contact list. Batch-14 --distinct on friend.status shows it is NOT a code column in practice (>50 distinct sentence-like TEXT values; the tool capped and flagged it), so status carries prose, not codes — do not map it as a code source.
_notes.entities.group.columns.group_id: The 'group' table's pk is NAMED userId but is read as the GROUP id (the g<id>.db file-name digits / shadow conv id for groups). Batch-14 --distinct on group.type shows {1: 98, 2: 2} (100 rows) — a small enum, unmapped, not needed for group_id.
_notes.msgId_overlap: The 2.3 AC (Desktop->shadow >= 99%) is NOT reachable by mapping iteration today: TOTAL pct=69.5% (desktop=380 shadow=269 matched=264) and every miss is capture-side, not mapping-side — the unmatched Desktop rows are messages the web client never fetched (mobile-sent / pre-open history), while the 4 conversations the web captured completely match at 100.0% (163eeac11ae7, 6c611186d91f, 558360fc9ca5, 248d15729e01 — h12). Three picked conversations have 1-3 shadow rows whose time range does not intersect the Desktop range at all (bogus/zero ts on the capture side) and group=0 conversations were selectable. Re-probe after the capture build is redeployed and those conversations are re-fetched.
